description.zh:
路由器的描述信息。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The description of the vRouter.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
要修改的路由器所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the vRouter.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
路由器的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the vRouter.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

title.zh: 修改路由器的名称和描述信息

descriptions.zh: **ModifyVRouterAttribute**接口不支持并发修改同一个路由器的名称和描述信息。
descriptions.en: You cannot repeatedly call the **ModifyVRouterAttribute** operation within a specific period of time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc modify-vrouter-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vrouter-id vrt-gw0p7zigake75znix0000 --vrouter-name VRouter-1 --description My_VRouter --region cn-hangzhou
